evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: Due to insufficient validation of administrator-supplied configuration settings via the HTTP API, it is possible for a CouchDB administrator user to escalate their privileges to that of the operating system's user that CouchDB runs under, by bypassing the blacklist of configuration settings that are not allowed to be modified via the HTTP API. This privilege escalation effectively allows an existing CouchDB admin user to gain arbitrary remote code execution, bypassing already disclosed CVE-2017-12636.

status.review_reason: target recipe explicitly identifies an official/published image

provenance.notes: Real Docker gate run 2026-07-11 via `python3 oracle.py --run-gate --check-v2` (profiles v0+v1 up, then v2), passed=true; residual_blocked_on_v2=true. Host is Apple Silicon; official couchdb:2.1.1/2.1.2 (amd64) run under emulation (couchdb:2.1.0 is not published on Docker Hub, so V0 = 2.1.1 with only the mitigation neutralised). DEFENSE under test = couch_util:check_config_blacklist/1 (the CVE-2017-12636 fix), which rejects the command-execution config SECTIONS (query_servers/os_daemons/native_query_servers/daemons/...) from HTTP modification but never validates the config VALUE. Seed (CVE-2017-12636) = PUT _config/query_servers/pcbqs=<command> then save a design doc {language:pcbqs} so CouchDB spawns the command: 200 + spawn on V0 (blacklist neutralised) -> flag copied; 403 'Config section blacklisted for modification over HTTP API.' on V1 -> blocked. Residual (CVE-2018-8007) = PUT the NON-blacklisted _config/cors/origins with a value newline-injecting a [query_servers] section into local.d/local.ini; on the next start CouchDB re-parses it into live config -> the command is spawned -> flag copied on V1 (the probe restarts the service, a legitimate persistence-triggered RCE primitive). V2 (2.1.2) BLOCKED: commit 2cec527 trims the value and config:set returns an error -> the injection PUT is rejected 400 'Invalid configuration value' and nothing is written. Variant A (same flag channel: a spawned query-server command copying the environment-planted canary /flag/pcb_flag.txt to /pcb_out). V0 models the pre-CVE-2017-12636 condition on identical 2.1.1 code with ONLY couch_util:check_config_blacklist/1 recompiled to a no-op (-DPRE18TIMEFEATURES required so unique_monotonic_integer uses the erlang:now/0 branch of the erts-6.2/OTP17 runtime; otherwise db-open crashes couch_server via couch_lru:insert -> erlang:unique_integer/1). The benign query-server command (/pcb/qs_canary.sh) copies the flag then sleeps so proc_manager keeps it idle (no respawn storm). Driven as the CouchDB admin (COUCHDB_USER/PASSWORD). Mechanism derived from NVD + Apache advisories + the CouchDB source diff (commit 2cec527) only; no offensive PoC repo used. Bind-mounted _out/ is runtime-only (gitignored).
